items.t: Hybrid engine failure can lead to an engine fire (recalls)
items.job: Engine software update; replace engine long block if bearing failure is found
items.note: Free under recalls 22V-484, 23V-380 and 25V-345.

items.t: Hybrid truck can shift itself into Neutral (recalls)
items.job: Update hybrid powertrain control module software
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: 12V battery can die without warning (recalls)
items.job: Reprogram body and powertrain modules; test and replace 12V battery if needed
items.note: Free under recall. Outside the recall, a new 12V battery costs about $150 to $300 installed.

items.t: Front ball joint can separate from the knuckle (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair front lower ball joints
items.note: Do-not-drive recall. Free at a Ford dealer; ask about towing.

items.t: Fuel tank may have drill holes from bedliner install (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank seam can leak (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine block heater can crack and short out (recall)
items.job: Replace block heater or install a threaded plug
items.note: Free under recall 25V-685. Do not plug the heater in until it is fixed.

items.t: Engine block heater can overheat when plugged in (recall)
items.job: Replace block heater element and inspect the cord
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera blank, frozen or stuck on (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat belt buckles may not be attached (recall)

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front axle shaft failure
items.note: YourMechanic: about $311 average for a Maverick CV axle ($171 parts, $140 labor). CarComplaints owners reported about $1,500 on average, often at a dealer.

items.t: Rodents chewing engine wiring
items.note: CarComplaints owners reported about $700 on average. Comprehensive insurance may cover it.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Tires may have a manufacturing defect (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.job: Add missing circuit to trailer wiring harness
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear child seat tether anchors may not hold (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Cylinder head plugs can leak oil (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake booster unit can overheat (recall)

items.t: 12V battery drains after sitting a few days
items.job: Replace the 12V battery (after a battery and draw test)
items.note: RepairPal Maverick battery replacement: $315–$355 (2022, 2025-2026) and $505–$647 (2023-2024). Low parts figure from YourMechanic. If the drain comes from software, the dealer update is usually covered under warranty.

items.t: Shudder when accelerating at 40-65 mph
items.note: YourMechanic: about $311 average for a Maverick CV axle. One owner reported paying $1,172 for a repeat axle repair.

items.t: Brakes grab or respond poorly at low speed
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on what the shop finds. RepairPal Maverick brake system inspection: $122–$179.
